text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT: streaming/v1 p99 latency spike detected >5000ms in eu-central after recent precision-profile rollout (rollout-id: rp-2026-04-15-09). Auto-page: oncall.
oncall-bot: Paging @alex (on-call) and @maya (primary on-call backup). Severity: P1. Route: streaming/v1. Customer-impact: possible partial degradations for long-context streams.
alex: ack — I'm on it, joining call in 2. Triage starting now. Can someone grab quick dashboards (p95/p99 + stream stall rate)?
maya: grabbing graphs — p95 ~1200ms (baseline ~200ms), p99 ~5200ms, streaming_stall_rate ~3.2% (normal ~0.1%). Error budget alarms firing for several customers. See link: https://console.redwood/in/streams/streaming-v1/metrics
sam: noticed this coincided with the precision profile rollout 09:05Z that introduced mixed int8/fp8 variant for long sequence paths. rollout-id matches ops-bot. Rolling traffic to new profile started at 09:06.
jia: from calib-service logs (09:08-09:12) there are repeated calibration failures; looks like quant table checksum mismatches and then fallback to dequant path which is slower under heavy KV pressure. Snippet:
```
[2026-04-15T09:09:11Z] calib: load_quant_table rp-2026-04-15-09 failed checksum
[2026-04-15T09:09:12Z] dequanter: fallback -> slow_dequant_path seq=2048 model=mix-int8-fp8 latency=3.1s
[2026-04-15T09:11:03Z] kv_cache_miss ratio=0.77 burst=high
```
maya: yeah I can reproduce locally-ish on a canary node — dequant path hits high memory churn -> GC pauses -> stalls streaming generator. p99 dominated by tail stalls from dequant.
alex: initial hypothesis: calibration rollout produced a quant table mismatch causing many requests to hit a slower dequant fallback; combined with large seq lengths and KV cache churn -> tail blowup. Customer-impact likely for long-context streaming calls. Plan: 1) immediate traffic mitigation: divert traffic off new profile, 2) if safe, rollback profile to previous stable, 3) keep canary capacity isolated and run further postmortem checks.
sam: recommend rollback to rp-2026-04-14-22 (last known-good). If we rollback on routing layer we can avoid full infra redeploy. Suggest routed rollback + temporarily increase caching TTL for KV to reduce miss storm.

alex: executing: `redwood routing update --route streaming/v1 --profile rp-2026-04-14-22 --weight 100 --wait` (will push 100% to stable)
ops-bot: action started by alex at 09:16Z — updating routing

alex: update — routing API returned 202 accepted. Starting gradual drain of mixed-profile nodes.

maya: side-action: bump kv cache TTL for streaming keys from 30s -> 300s to blunt miss bursts. Command: `kvctl set-ttl --pool streaming-cache --ttl 300s` (done at 09:17Z)
jia: noted that calib-service had a restart loop on a subset of canaries around 09:10Z; opening a follow-up ticket for checksum root-cause. For now we should quarantine any newly onboarded quant tables: mark rp-2026-04-15-09 as quarantined in model-catalog.

sam: roll back complete? alex?
alex: routing reports success at 09:18Z. Traffic now on rp-2026-04-14-22.

maya: monitoring — p95 dropping: 09:20 p95=480ms, p99=900ms, streaming_stall_rate=0.5%
alex: nice. continuing to observe. will keep 1:1 canary off until we validate calibration pipeline.

leo: headed off-thread to CS ops: informing top 5 affected customers (ACME, OmniRetail, DocuStream) with templated notification: "We're mitigating increased latency on streaming endpoints; we rolled back the recent precision profile; our ops team is monitoring. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes." (sent 09:21Z) — tracked in ticket #INC-4021.

maya: at 09:24 p95=230ms, p99=340ms, stall_rate=0.08% — basically back to baseline. No obvious error rate increase now. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks everyone. immediate mitigations: rollback + TTL bump + quarantined profile. Next steps: 1) postmortem on calibration checksum validation, 2) add preflight against KV/GC conditions for dequant fallback, 3) improve canary gating for mixed-precision rollouts (sequence-length aware).

jia: will own the calibration postmortem. I'll collect logs, checksum diff, and reproduce. Owning remediation (eta initial findings 24h).
sam: I'll follow up on routing safeguards and add a circuit-breaker to stop profile rollouts if dequant fallback rate >1% during canary.

alex: handing ops to @maya for the next 6hrs — I'm tied into an incident call. If anything regresses ping me direct. Leaving notes in the incident ticket INC-4021 and will write quick playbook steps.

leo: capturing customer impact summary for postmortem. ACME reported high latencies but no request loss; will include timeline and mitigation notes.

maya: closing active page for now; will keep watches for 2 hours and escalate if we see >2x baseline p99 or >1% stall_rate. Good recovery. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation applied: rollback to rp-2026-04-14-22, kv TTL increased, rp-2026-04-15-09 quarantined). Auto-close in 2h if no regressions.
